svg.aria-label: UML class diagram of Aalmaram Health in two packages. What we offer: a Module groups Catalogues, a Catalogue classifies Components, a Vendor offers Components and has Branches and Practitioners, Components are delivered by Practitioners, and Vendors post FeedPosts. The client's journey: a Client takes Trips, has Conversations and builds up ClientPreferences, with a Staff relationship manager; a Trip has TripRequirements, exactly one Itinerary and a HealthDossier; the Itinerary is paid by Payments and made of ItineraryItems, each placing one Component at an optional Branch and booked through one Booking that logs BookingEvents.
svg.text: v1 · 15 Oct 2026 · from the 14 and 15 Oct sessions with Nivedith
